note: Cabo Verde's largest bank, the Banco Comercial do Atlântico, was read; the Caixa Económica's and Banco Interatlântico's price lists weren't reached. The BCA's price list (in force from 30 July 2026), read in full for its credit cards: the BCA Visa Classic and Gold cost 4,000 and 7,000 escudos a year for the main card, charge a nominal 18.250% a year (22.345% effective), 221 escudos plus 1% for a cash advance in Cabo Verde (331 plus 1% abroad; the domestic one is written), 1.7% on purchases outside Cabo Verde and 1% of the amount over the limit. Stamp duty of 3.5% is added to every fee and to the interest, written as tax (this file wrote the Classic's fee with its stamp duty, 4,140, before the form had a tax term); the further 0.05% stamp duty on the month's average balance has no form in the game and isn't written. The late payment charge (331 escudos plus 2%) doesn't say 2% of what, so it isn't written; nor is the 1% charged on a change of limit, whose base isn't stated. The corporate card isn't written.
